newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse seen lifted by dollar on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse seen lifted by dollar on Tuesday.

text.p: French shares were expected to open higher in a quiet market, lifted by the dollar, traders said. Many dealers away as France enters summer holiday season.
Stocks to watch include all companies related to Thomson-CSF privatisation, dealers said.

* Lagardere seen lower, while Alcatel may climb since speculation rife that government, having cancelled Thomson-CSF privatisation on Friday, may tie Alcatel to Thomson-CSF, Dassault and Aerospatiale to create big French defence company.
*LVMH opening direction seen uncertain but one dealer said market likely to maintain confidence in company chairman Bernard Arnault in his battle with Guinness and Grand Met.
French newspaper reports said on Tuesday that Arnault would be presenting proposals before the end of the week to counter Guinness/Grand Met merger.
* CAC-40 Jul futures 2,970 vs 2,950 at Fridays close.
